subjects.label: Earlier entries in the series
subjects.description: This game measured against the earlier games in its own series: which one was better, whether the series peaked years ago, being fooled by the last one and buying again, or calling this the best of them; comparisons with other franchises or genres do not belong here.

subjects.label: Launch state and recovery
subjects.description: The game as shipped versus the game now: released unfinished, wait for updates, a botched launch mourned by pre-orders, whether it has since become good or is trying to come back from the dead; ordinary patch notes and roadmap talk without the launch arc do not belong here.

subjects.label: Vehicles and aircraft
subjects.description: Tanks, helicopters, jets and boats: how they handle, lock-on and missiles, landing, repair, tanks spawned on rooftops and being run over on foot; infantry gunplay does not belong here.

subjects.label: Getting into a match
subjects.description: Failing to reach the publisher's servers, load errors between rounds, being kicked partway through a match and servers too poor to play on; lag once inside a working match and player counts do not belong here.

subjects.label: Anti-cheat and machine requirements
subjects.description: The anti-cheat and what it demands of the machine: a black screen after it initialises, an anti-cheat error that forced a disk reset, a change that requires altering BIOS settings to launch; ordinary crashes with no anti-cheat involved do not belong here.

subjects.label: Gunplay and shooting feel
subjects.description: How the guns feel to fire: no sense of impact, missing recoil, shots that do not seem to land; vehicles and the wider match loop do not belong here.

subjects.label: Factions, politics and representation
subjects.description: Who the game has you fight for and as: the same two nations pitted against each other in every mode read as propaganda, the ethnicity and identity of the soldiers on each side and complaints about representation; jokes and copypasta about real-world politics unrelated to the game do not belong here.

subjects.label: Recipes instead of a review
subjects.description: A cooking recipe posted in place of a review, usually with a line saying the game is not worth reviewing; other jokes, memes and ASCII art do not belong here.

subjects.label: Seasons and pass rewards
subjects.description: The seasonal content drops, the free or paid pass and playing only to unlock a skin from it; the price of the game itself and general microtransaction complaints do not belong here.

subjects.label: Blame for the studio
subjects.description: Reviews addressed to the developer as a company, demanding it be punished or driven out of the industry for what it shipped; ordinary complaints about patches or a lack of communication do not belong here.
